Title: OWCS Developer (Content Management) 
 Location: Woodland Hills, CA
 Duration: 6 to 12 months
 Interview: Phone and Skype
 
 Job description:- 
 · Minimum 3 years of experience in Oracle Web Center Sites platform
 · Development experience in Oracle document cloud, WebCenter Content/ WebCenter portal.
 · Experience in administration of the Oracle Webcenter Sites platform (Infrastructure and deployment)
 · Good knowledge of Engage engine and visitor services for content personalization
 · Experience with integrating OWCS with other products and vendors specifically targeting Social Integrations.
 · Design and build components, templates, dialogs, and workflows using the OWCS architecture. 
 · Java – Spring, Hibernate and AngularJS Technical exposure
 · Desired years of experience : 10-12 years of IT experience
 · Education/ Certifications (Required) : Bachelors or Master’s Degree
 · Design, Develop, lead and implement WebCenter Sites Implementation and WebCenter Sites Upgrade/Migration
 · Design and build components, templates, dialogs, and workflows using the OWCS architecture.
 · REST services development and deployment

 Graduate
